title: MA61040: Computations On Finite Fields
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite: Modern AlgebraFinite Fields, construction and examples,
polynomials on finite fields and their irreducibility, applications to
polynomial coding. Irreducible polynomials over finite fields, factorization of
polynomials over finite fields. Combinatorial applications -Hadamard matrices,
balanced incomplete block designs. Automata - Semi automata and automata,
examples, algorithms and related programs.
